lines.en: Once again, I decide to kill some time at the mall.
This time, however, it doesn’t look like Chika is on her normal bench.
I suppose my streak of perfect convenience comes to an end today as I must now scan the halls of this brightly colored, obnoxiously loud building in order to find her.
But it is what it is, I guess.
I was honestly beginning to question whether or not she even had a job or if she was just pretending to have one to impress me.
Granted, she could actually be working right now, but...I don't know.
I won't believe it until I see it.
I walk around the mall for a good ten minutes or so without any sign of Chika, meaning she’s either off today or on the clock right now.
If I remember correctly, I think she said she worked at some high-end boutique or something along those lines.
The only problem is that I have no idea what counts as high-end, so I don't even have a place to start.
Not knowing what else to do, I check out a nearby directory and pinpoint the store with the fanciest name I can find before beginning my search there...
: Hey, welcome-
: Woah! Sensei! I had no idea you were coming in today!
Chika excitedly throws a handbag onto a display shelf and hurries over to me.
: Hey! What are you doing here? Shopping on your day off?
: We're actually having a sale on men's clothing right now, so instead of everything costing like, 90%% of your annual salary, it's probably closer to, like...70%%.
: Wow, you really weren’t kidding when you said ‘high-end’ were you?
: Hahahah~ Oh, come on! You know I’m just messing around!! There's no way we'd charge more than 60%% of your annual salary, tops.
: You know, I think I'll stick to my one outfit.
: I get it, no worries. I guess everything here is still kind of expensive when you compare it to...literally everywhere else.
: But you’re like, a big shot teacher, right? I’m sure you’ve got some extra cash to spare.
: I mean...I wouldn't say I'm poor by any means, but I'm not really sitting on a mountain of cash either.
: Besides, I don’t really think any of this stuff would suit me.
: Hey, don’t say that! I think you’d look really handsome in some of our stuff.
: I can help you pick some stuff out, if you want. I'm pretty good at that sort of thing.
: Maybe some other time. I sort of just dropped by to see how you were doing today.
: Oh my God! Did you really come all the way over here just to see me?! That’s like, totally adorable!
: How come? Isn’t there someone like, closer to your age you’d rather spend your time with?
: Someone I’d rather hang out with than Chika Chosokabe? Unlikely.
: Oh, stop it. I don't believe that for even a second.
: There’s gotta be someone out there you’ve got, like...more in common with or whatever.
: I don’t think we need to have anything in common to enjoy being around each other.
: If you enjoy being around me, I mean.
: Oh my God, of course I like being around you! Haven’t you noticed that I’ve been skipping class waaaaay less often lately?
: My grades have been getting a little better-ish, too!
: I mean, I’m sure that’s also thanks to you barely giving us any work, but yeah. I like you.
: Oh! Wait! No! Not like that! That...That probably sounded weird, didn't it? Like...I like you as a teacher. Or a...friend. Or something.
: Don’t worry, Chika. I like you too.
: I...okay! Yeah!
: We...like each other! Which is awesome!
: Well, uhh...just so you know, you can come hang out here whenever you want.
: I work most of my shifts alone, so as long as my boss isn’t here and it’s not super busy, I'd love to see you.
: And who knows? Maybe I’ll even let you judge some of the stuff I try on but can’t afford!
: Well, I'm not really known for my fashion sense, but I’d love seeing you dress up.
: You’re in luck, then! Part of the job is knowing what would look good on who, and I can't really know that without trying stuff on myself.
: Again, not a fashion icon, but I don't really think that's true.
: Well, I won't tell anyone you're here to watch me try on clothes if you don't tell anyone that it's a perk I've been taking advantage of.
: Just kinda wish dresses looked a little better on me.
: Really? Why is that?
: Mmm...Idunno. I guess they just don’t really fit my style?
: All the clothes I wear are pretty flashy, so trying on cutesy stuff just makes me feel like a loser.
: I’m sure you don’t look like a loser. I can't really see anything not working on you, if you want my opinion.
: In fact, I'm going to seize this opportunity and say that you should model a dress for me before anything else.
: How come we've gotta start on hard mode?! What about, like...a tank top or something?

: We've got a whole lingerie section too, you know. Which isn't me implying that I'd model any of it for you. But at this point I'm just trying to steer the conversation away from the dress thing and-
: If lingerie is off the table, I'm going to stick to the dress suggestion.
: I mean...I wouldn't say it's off the table forever...just...
: Oh my God. What am I even saying right now? I'm sorry, Sensei. I just-
: There's no need to apologize. Other teachers might get weirded out by the idea of a student offering to one day model underwear for them, but not me.
: Which sounds a lot worse when I say it out loud, but I can guarantee it's-
: Uhh...would you maybe...mind keeping your voice down a little? I don't really have a problem with what we're talking about, but I don't want you to, like...get in trouble or anything.
I quickly look around to make sure no one's been paying attention to the conversation and confirm that we at least appear to have gone unnoticed just now.
: I think we're fine. But yeah, that's probably not something we should talk about.
: Even if it was a completely normal conversation between two people without any ulterior motives whatsoever.
: See, this is why I like you! You’re so chill about everything and like, never make me feel uncomfortable even when we're talking about uncomfortable stuff.
: It's kind of like you’re my...big brother or something.
: You would model lingerie for your big brother?
: Well, I-
: Uhh...
: No! Of course not!
: Also, I thought we were moving on!
: I'm sorry if this bursts your bubble, Chika, but I don't really see you as a little sister.
: Well...what do you see me as, Sensei? Just out of curiosity.
: I’ve never had a teacher come visit me at work before. And it’s not like I really view you as just a teacher either, so...
: I view you as Chika.
: That feels...weirdly embarrassing to hear for some reason...
: Like, I’m glad you see me as me and not just some...flirty bimbo who’s always breaking dress code and stuff.
: It would be kind of hard to view you as a flirty bimbo since you recently confirmed to me that you’ve never done anything with a boy before.
: Well, that's not because I’m against it! I just...haven't met the right person yet! Nobody's really interested me or whatever!
: Plus, I’m super busy all the time and like, no one’s schedule would ever match up with mine.
: You think so? Because my schedule seems to match up pretty nicely. We even see each other during[school] days.
: Yeah, but it’s not like I can have my teacher as a boyfriend, right? Isn’t that like, totally against the rules?
: Since when do you care about rules?
: Ooooh, good point. So what, then? You wanna go out, Sensei?
: Would you be able to keep it a secret?
: Wait, we're still joking, right? I wasn’t...really being serious, but you look super serious right now and it's making me unsure of how to answer.
I guess I should probably wait a little longer before I go down that path with Chika.
I keep forgetting how innocent she is despite her subconscious desire to flirt with me every second of the day.
I can definitely feel the two of us getting closer quickly, so I'm sure more is bound to happen eventually, but...
: Let's take a rain check on dating. I need to at least see you in lingerie before I make my final decision.
: Heheh...sounds good to me.
: I guess all we can really do is hope you’re not disappointed whenever that time finally comes...
Chika and I hang out for a little while longer before a few customers walk in and she needs to focus on them.
I decide it’s time to head back and we say our goodbyes to one another.
Having no other reason to stay at the mall, I board a bus back to the main part of the city and attempt to figure out what to do with the rest of my day...
Chika’s affection has increased to [chika_love]!
